name: ks-social-contributions
description: Use this skill whenever asked about Kansas employer social contributions for tax year 2026, state unemployment insurance (UI) contributions, the UI-only nature of Kansas employer social cost (no state disability, no paid-family-leave, no state health mandate), and the interaction with federal FUTA. Trigger on "Kansas unemployment insurance", "Kansas UI rate", "Kansas employer contributions", "K.S.A. 79-27", "KW-3 UI". Source-cited draft; the 2026 wage base, rate ranges and filing calendar are not yet confirmed (dol.ks.gov returned 403 to plain HTTP this run).
